current_concerns.primary_problems: Severe preoccupation with food at home and in daily routines, including calorie counting and organizing the day around eating. She feels uncomfortable if she has not planned food in advance, sometimes avoids eating with others, and finds the day exhausting because this occupies her thoughts much of the time. She is also preoccupied with her body shape, which remains on her mind.
